title: HAY DAY TEAMS UP WITH MOST HAUNTED'S YVETTE FIELDING FOR SPOOKY HALLOWEEN GHOST HUNT!
excerpt: Supercell's beloved farming game Hay Day is embracing the supernatural this Halloween, teaming up with legendary British paranormal investigator and Most Haunted presenter Yvette Fielding for a spine-tingling collaboration that brings ghost hunting, haunted farms and a mysterious vampire-inspired villain together.
content:
Supercell’s beloved farming game Hay Day is embracing the supernatural this Halloween, teaming up with legendary British paranormal investigator and Most Haunted presenter Yvette Fielding for a spine-tingling collaboration that brings ghost hunting, haunted farms and a mysterious vampire-inspired villain together.

Halloween has officially arrived on the farm, and things are getting considerably creepier. While players of Hay Day are usually busy harvesting crops, caring for animals and building their dream countryside escape, this October sees the popular mobile game swap some of its usual cosy charm for a supernatural adventure.

In an unexpected collaboration, Hay Day has joined forces with Yvette Fielding, one of Britain’s most recognisable paranormal investigators, to celebrate its limited-time Haunted Farms Halloween event, running until 31 October 2026.

The campaign combines a real-life ghost investigation at one of England’s historic haunted locations with an interactive in-game storyline, introducing players to a mysterious new character known as the Red Revenant.

And with Halloween fast approaching, the Hay Day community must work together to break an ancient curse before their farms fall victim to the supernatural.

Best known for presenting the cult paranormal television series Most Haunted, Yvette Fielding has spent years exploring allegedly haunted buildings, investigating unexplained phenomena and attempting to communicate with spirits.

Now, she’s bringing that experience into the colourful world of Hay Day.

To celebrate the game’s Halloween takeover, Fielding travels to Cogges Manor Farm in Oxfordshire, a historic English farm with a reputation for ghostly activity.

In a special Most Haunted episode created for the collaboration, the paranormal investigator attempts to make contact with a mysterious spirit rumoured to be the ghost of a Count who once owned the land.

However, rather than simply investigating unexplained noises or searching for signs of paranormal activity, Fielding takes a decidedly modern approach to communicating with the supernatural.

She invites the mysterious ghost to play Hay Day.

The unusual encounter provides the inspiration for the game’s Halloween storyline, blending Fielding’s paranormal expertise with the playful, imaginative world of mobile gaming.

For fans of Most Haunted, the collaboration offers a different kind of ghost hunt, while Hay Day players get to experience their favourite farming game through an unexpectedly spooky lens.

Inside Cogges Manor Farm: The Real-Life Haunted Location!

The setting for Fielding’s investigation is Cogges Manor Farm, a historic property in Witney, Oxfordshire.

Known for its centuries-old buildings, agricultural heritage and traditional English countryside surroundings, Cogges provides an atmospheric backdrop for a Halloween ghost hunt.

The historic site is also familiar to television audiences thanks to its appearance as Yew Tree Farm in the acclaimed period drama Downton Abbey.

For the Hay Day collaboration, the location takes on a more sinister identity as Fielding investigates the legend of a mysterious Count.

The supernatural storyline connects the real-world investigation to the game’s Halloween experience, creating a crossover between British paranormal television, historic locations and interactive gaming.

Those interested in the location’s history can explore more through the official Cogges Manor Farm website.

Meet The Red Revenant: Hay Day’s New Halloween Villain!

At the centre of the Haunted Farms Halloween event is the arrival of the Red Revenant, a vampire-inspired character with a sinister mission.

Determined to reclaim his castle, the mysterious figure threatens to bring a supernatural curse to the peaceful farming community.

Rather than focusing entirely on the usual farming activities, the Halloween storyline encourages players to unite against the new threat.

The challenge is simple: work together, lift the Red Revenant’s curse and save the farms before Halloween ends.

The storyline gives Hay Day’s familiar farming environment a seasonal twist, introducing an element of mystery and adventure without abandoning the game’s community-focused appeal.

For long-time players, it’s an opportunity to experience the game in a different way. For newcomers, the Halloween takeover offers a timely reason to discover the popular mobile title.

Haunted Farms Halloween Event Runs Until 31 October!

Players have until Halloween to take part in the limited-time Haunted Farms storyline.

The event brings together the spooky atmosphere of Halloween with the relaxed gameplay that has helped Hay Day become a recognisable name in mobile gaming.

Created by Finnish game developer Supercell, Hay Day allows players to build and customise farms, grow crops, raise animals, trade goods and connect with other players.

The game’s accessible gameplay and colourful countryside setting have helped it maintain a dedicated community since its original release in 2012.

With Haunted Farms, Supercell is giving that familiar world a supernatural makeover, adding a vampire-inspired antagonist and a community challenge designed around the Halloween season.

The limited-time event concludes on 31 October, making the final days of October the opportunity for players to get involved in the ghostly adventure.

Why Hay Day’s Halloween Collaboration Is A Perfect Pop Culture Crossover!

There’s something wonderfully unexpected about combining a comforting farming simulator with one of British television’s best-known paranormal personalities.

Hay Day is associated with colourful animals, countryside life and relaxed gameplay, while Most Haunted is famous for its eerie investigations, unexplained encounters and supernatural storytelling.

By bringing the two worlds together, Supercell has created a Halloween campaign that appeals to several audiences, from dedicated mobile gamers to fans of paranormal entertainment.

The collaboration also reflects the growing crossover between gaming, television personalities and immersive branded entertainment, with campaigns increasingly extending beyond the game itself.

Instead of introducing only a seasonal character, Hay Day has created a real-world paranormal investigation that connects directly to its in-game narrative.

The result is a playful contrast between the supposedly terrifying and the delightfully cosy.

Watch Yvette Fielding’s Special Most Haunted Episode!

Fans can watch the special Halloween investigation featuring Yvette Fielding as she visits Cogges Manor Farm and attempts to communicate with the mysterious Count.

The episode brings the Haunted Farms storyline into the real world, offering viewers a paranormal adventure with an unexpected gaming twist.

How To Download Hay Day And Join The Halloween Event!

Anyone wanting to take part in the Haunted Farms Halloween adventure can download Hay Day for free on compatible iOS and Android devices, with optional in-app purchases.

Whether you’re a long-time Hay Day player, a dedicated Most Haunted viewer or simply looking for a different way to celebrate spooky season, the Haunted Farms event offers a Halloween adventure with a paranormal twist.

Just remember: the clock is ticking, the Red Revenant wants his castle back, and the fate of the farm is in the community’s hands.

Hay Day’s Haunted Farms Halloween event runs until 31 October 2026.
